prior_exposure: Development comparison. V1 results already observed. Not an untouched test or generalization estimate.
selection: Same 24 frozen dev cases; train smoke uses first two per class from deterministic selection.
candidate_policy: Forced initial search top3; model selects unread doc or verdict with one of lexical top3 sentences per read document; abstain always available. Last step finish-only. At most 26 one-token letter options.
scoring: Greedy argmax raw next-token logit among A..Z single-token IDs. Conditional softmax over legal options logged; not calibrated confidence. Stable option order, positional bias not controlled.
baseline: Same model chooses finish-only using all top3 abstracts and same sentence candidates; always-NEI non-LLM baseline.
